lead: I sit between design and engineering, and I have never been able to pick a side.
paragraphs: Most of my work is the part people actually touch: the interaction that has to feel right, the page that has to load on a bad connection, the empty state nobody thought about. I care about software that holds up under a real hand.

Before this I ran infrastructure at a fintech, which is where I learned that the fastest interface is the one that does not need to ask the server. I like small teams, short feedback loops, and shipping things people can try the same week.

now.text: Building a physics-driven design tool on weekends.
Learning compute shaders, slowly and badly.
Open to product-engineering roles and select freelance.
